# Career OS

> Self-hosted, provider-agnostic Personal AI Career Operating System. pnpm/Turborepo monorepo (Next.js 16, NestJS 10, BullMQ, Electron); Postgres is the system of record, LLMs are not. Alpha, pre-v0.1.

This file is the discovery index for AI tools and agents. Start here, then load the documents by topic. All documents are plain Markdown so any model or agent can read them. A machine-readable manifest lives in `codebase.index.json`.

## Essential

- [Career OS — Knowledge Base](README.md): Big picture, document index, divergences
- [Career OS — AI Context Brief](AI_CONTEXT.md): Compact single-file brief for pasting into a model context
- [Technology Stack](STACK.md): Languages, runtimes, dependencies, commands, environment

## Reference

- [Codebase Structure](STRUCTURE.md): Directory layout, entry points, module boundaries, naming
- [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md): System flow, layers, reused patterns, architectural risks
- [Coding Conventions](CONVENTIONS.md): Naming, formatting/lint, imports, errors and logging, testing rules
- [External Integrations](INTEGRATIONS.md): External APIs, data stores, secrets, reliability, observability
- [Testing Patterns](TESTING.md): Test frameworks, layout, scope, mocking, CI gates, gaps
- [Codebase Concerns](CONCERNS.md): Prioritised risks, technical debt, security, open questions

## Optional

- [codebase.index.json](codebase.index.json): Machine-readable index (topics, token estimates, entry points, stack).
- [stack.json](stack.json): Tech-stack manifest.
- [kb-technical.html](kb-technical.html): Print-ready A4 document (needs a browser with internet).
- [kb-public.html](kb-public.html): Print-ready A4 document (needs a browser with internet).

## How to use this knowledge base

1. Load `README.md` for the big picture, or `codebase.index.json` for machine-readable discovery.
2. For a quick, low-token brief, load `AI_CONTEXT.md`.
3. For a specific task, load the matching document from the lists above.
4. Every non-trivial claim cites a committed file path. `[TODO]` = not determinable from the repo; `[ASK USER]` = needs team intent.
5. Generated against commit `47be31a`; re-run the knowledge-base skill after significant changes.
